decision: The project name ChampHLA is restored. The primary method keeps its definition and is published as ChampHLA-Consensus.
rationale: The lead author prefers to continue under the established project name, under which the earlier analyses, drafts and co-author communication were carried out.
The change is label-only. No caller was re-run and no denominator, endpoint, statistic, figure datum or result registry value changes.

The method concern recorded in 20260917_project_rename is addressed in the manuscript text: the Introduction states that the name derives from the earlier champion-challenger design and that the primary method is the equal-weight plurality vote, with champion-challenger retained only as an exploratory comparator.
supersedes: decisions/20260917_project_rename.json (display name only; its rename rule and its list of identifiers that must never be renamed remain in force)
rename_rule: Unchanged from 20260917_project_rename: rename labels, never identifiers that live inside data.

renamed.display_method_name: PanelHLA-Consensus -> ChampHLA-Consensus (manuscripts, figure and table labels, result registry method descriptions, claim_audit.tsv claim text)
renamed.prose: manuscripts/benchmark/manuscript.md, manuscripts/benchmark/supplementary.md, manuscripts/shared/shared_methods.md, README.md, RECOVERY_STATUS.md, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, COAUTHOR_REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md, CITATION.cff, LICENSE copyright-holder phrase, pyproject.toml description
renamed.code_labels: docstrings, CLI titles and descriptions, docx titles and author metadata, figure axis labels and metadata, the ENA User-Agent string
renamed.live_decision_exception: decisions/publication_route.json is renamed, following the precedent set in 20260917_project_rename.

deliberately_not_renamed.reason: Both files are pinned by SHA-256 in signed decision records (20260928_truth_and_inference_amendment.json) and in artifacts/release_freeze.json. They record the display name in force when they were frozen; editing them would break the provenance chain. The method keys they define are unchanged.
